name: Richard Seaman
features: fair skin, dark hair neatly parted, dark eyes, long clean-cut handsome face, slim build, reserved courteous expression
bio: The only Englishman in the Mercedes-Benz works team, signed for 1937 after a season of embarrassing the Grand Prix establishment with a ten-year-old Delage voiturette. Seaman won the 1938 German Grand Prix at the Nürburgring. He crashed in the rain while leading at Spa in 1939 and died of his burns that night, aged 26.
